content.value: The primary and secondary windings of a 300KVA, 6000/230V transformer have resistance of 10 Ω and 0.016 Ω respectively. The total reactance of the transformer referred to the primary is 3 Ω. Calculate the percentage regulation of the transformer when supplying full load current at a power factor of 0.8 lagging.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 2nd Year 1st Term Regular Examination, 2018
